summary.text: Cynthia Creem is a Democratic state senator representing the Norfolk and Middlesex District and serves as state Senate majority leader; she is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
Ballotpedia lists her tenure in the State Senate as beginning in 1999, and she is an attorney.

paragraphs.text: Cynthia Stone Creem earned a B.S. in business administration and a J.D. from Boston University.
Her career experience includes working as an attorney, and she has served on the Newton Board of Aldermen.
Creem served on the Massachusetts Governor's Council from 1995 to 1999 before beginning her State Senate tenure in 1999.
In the 2025-2026 session she chaired the Senate Global Warming and Climate Change Committee and was vice chair of the Senate Committee on Juvenile and Emerging Adult Justice.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.
